verdict.rationale: Discord is a communication platform with a public developer API, so an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack documents only adjacent building blocks: the REST API, Gateway, bot and OAuth2 auth, llms.txt docs, and a preview OpenAPI spec. None of these is a first-party MCP server, so there is no evidence it delivers this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
